_doc: Curated registry of external RasQberry demos. Each entry pins a third-party demo repository to a full 40-character commit SHA; adding or updating an entry is a reviewed RasQberry PR and is the trust anchor for external demos. Fields per entry: id (kebab-case, must match the demo's rqb-demo.json id and its repo directory name), repo_url (must be https://), ref (full 40-char commit SHA - never a branch or tag), manifest_path (path to the manifest inside the repo, usually rqb-demo.json), added (YYYY-MM-DD), note (optional curator note), name and summary (optional, shown in the catalogue picker as one line, "Name (beta) - summary" in at most 66 characters), provider (optional, who provides and maintains the demo, shown in the install question as "Provided by <provider>."; without it: an external contributor), download (optional {download_mb, disk_mb}, shown before installing and on the first start), maturity (optional, "beta" for a new or less-tested demo: a (beta) tag in the menus and a feedback invitation at its start), group (optional, a group id from demo-manifests/demo-groups.json: its desktop folder and menu submenu; without it a catalogue demo goes to Contributed demos, whatever its manifest says), icon (optional, a file in desktop-icons/ (installed to /usr/share/icons/rasqberry/) for its desktop icon, unless the demo brings its own picture (icon.type custom)), leds (optional, true for a demo that drives the LED panel: the install question then says that it runs with root privileges, and no second question follows; a demo whose manifest needs the LEDs without it is asked about separately), own_stop_hint (optional, the exact line the demo prints about stopping it, e.g. 'Ctrl+C to exit': left out of its window, which shows RasQberry's own stop line), replaces (optional, the ids this demo had before a rename, e.g. ["traqmania"]: a Pi with one of them installed is offered this demo, which removes the old one (its checkout, menu entry, icon and Docker image) once it is installed; rq_demo_add_external.sh --update <old id> does the same, and until then the old install keeps this entry's group and maturity), formerly (optional, the name it had before a rename, e.g. "traQmania": the website's demo list shows it as "(formerly traQmania)", so that its users recognise it). Example entry: {"id": "example-demo", "repo_url": "https://github.com/someuser/example-demo.git", "ref": "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "manifest_path": "rqb-demo.json", "added": "2026-07-12", "note": "curator note"}. Install with: rq_demo_add_external.sh <id>. Update the pin with: rq_demo_add_external.sh --update <id>.

demos.name: racetraQ
demos.note: Quantum reinforcement-learning racing demo (https://racetraq.org; docker image ghcr.io/janlahmann/racetraq, public multi-arch incl. arm64). Renamed from traQmania on 2026-10-08 to keep clear of the Trackmania trademark: id, repository (JanLahmann/traQmania redirects) and image (ghcr.io/janlahmann/traqmania stays at its July build) all changed; replaces lists the old id, so a Pi with traQmania installed moves over. Pinned 2026-10-09 to racetraQ v0.2.0 (main). The download sizes are those of the traQmania image (arm64 about 510 MB compressed) - an estimate for racetraQ until its image is published. First Fun-with-Quantum-family catalog entry.

demos.name: SAP Quantum Learning
demos.note: SAP partner demo (Sameer-kulkarni-sk, MIT): browser quiz and drag-and-drop circuit composer, served from the committed production bundle via the web-static entrypoint - no Node or npm on the Pi. Pinned commit is the PR #1 merge, which brings the root build/ and package-lock.json we asked for.

demos.name: SAP Quantum LED
demos.summary: SAP logo on the LEDs, coloured by 3 qubits
demos.note: SAP partner demo (Sameer-kulkarni-sk, Apache-2.0): SAP logo on the LED matrix with colors drawn from a 3-qubit Aer circuit each cycle. Extracted from their RasQberry-Two fork on our request (issue #273); repo renamed to match the demo id. Re-pinned 2026-09-11 to the merge of our PR #3 (logo rendered upside down: SAP_PIXELS is authored bottom-origin, draw_sap now flips the row for the top-origin canvas); manifest unchanged.
